Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game and the multi-format series! It has been dominated by the hosts! The scoreline ended with 11-5 with the Aussies only losing one. We hope you enjoyed the coverage. Until next time, take care and goodbye!

Meg Lanning, the victorious skipper, is up for a chat. She says, they were looking forward to the the last game. They knew India would come hard at them and so they did, but she is glad the girls fought back and got over the line. Mentions, India really tested them and gave a tough challenge. Adds, Tahlia McGrath has been special and she is really proud of her. Thanks the efforts of Cricket Australia and all the health line workers to make sure the tour is possible.

Harmanpreet Kaur, captain of India Women is up for a chat. She says, she thinks they are on the right track and backs her players. Adds, they have proved themselves everytime they have come out on the pitch. Thanks the supports staff for their efforts behind the scenes. Adds that, she is excited for the Women’s Big Bash League and all the girls are looking forward to it.

Tahlia McGrath, Player of the match and Player of the series. She says it was an incredible series to be a part of. Adds that, it was certainly tough to bat across all formats but says she was lucky to get the runs on the board. Adds the things are really going well for her at the moment. Mentions, Mooney is really awesome to bat with. She recognised the situation, came down to me and said to keep her eyes on the ball.
... TIME FOR THE PRESENTATION ...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bowl, India had Australia on the back foot at 73 for 4. However, they let them off the hook by conceding far too many runs towards the back end. Courtesy Tahlia McGrath and Beth Mooney Australia got close to 150 which proved to be enough in the end.

The Australian bowlers were really good! They had to be, the target was not a big one and they needed to keep the Indians quiet initially. They bowled 6 good overs first up which build the pressure. There were overs in between where runs were leaked but they always managed to pick wickets which kept pushing India further behind in the game. Ashleigh Gardner was once again really good. Nicola Carey was also decent apart from that last over. Overall, it was a combined bowling effort and very good display in the field too.

Some really good hitting towards the end from Richa Ghosh but it was a little too late! We did mention India needed a good start from their openers but that was not the case as Shafali Verma fell early. Jemimah Rodrigues and Smriti Mandhana then took their time to get their eye in but the run rate needed kept on going up. When it was time to up the ante, Jemimah Rodrigues fell. Mandhana then along with Kaur revived the hopes. Mandhana got her fifty up but she needed to stay there right till the end. However, she fell immediately after that and then it was an uphill task for the batters coming in. Wickets then fell quickly, Richa Ghosh did strike a few meaty blows towards the end but to no avail.
FOUR! SMACKED! Richa Ghosh ends the innings on a high. A length ball, outside off. Ghosh reaches out and slaps it through covers for a boundary. AUSTRALIA WOMEN WIN THE GAME BY 14 RUNS.
SIX! Back-to-back maximums! A little to late for India. But these are good signs for the Indian unit. A length ball, on off. Ghosh hangs back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
SIX! All the way! A length ball, on middle and off. Ghosh makes room and lifts it over long off for a maximum.
Full and on off. Sharma whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off. Sharma looks to heave it away but misses.
FOUR! Nicely played! A length ball, on the pads. Sharma pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Full and on middle. Sharma pushes it towards long on for a single.
Full and on off. Ghosh reverse sweeps it to cover for a single.
Another single, as this is worked to long on.
Full and on off. Ghosh puhses it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, around leg. Ghosh comes down the track and looks to heave it away but misses. The keeper could not collect the ball as it stays low. Ghosh survives.
LEG BYE! Full and on leg. Sharma looks to flick it away but misses. The ball hits the pads and goes towards point. They collect a leg bye.
A length ball, on the pads. Sharma tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on off. Ghosh slaps it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Innovation at its best. A full-length ball, on off. Ghosh comes across and scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Full and on off. Ghosh hits it down the ground, but ends up hitting the wickets at the non-striker's end.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Deepti Sharma walks out now.

OUT! RUN OUT! Another one bites the dust. This is looking bad for India Women. A full-length ball, on the pads. Deol hangs back and clips it to deep mid-wicket. The batters decide to take two. The fielder collects the ball and throws it to the keeper at the striker's end. Alyssa Healy collects the ball and whips the bails in no time. The umpire takes it upstairs and the replays show Deol was way outside the crease.
Is that run out? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays roll in to show Deol was short by a long margin. She has to depart.
An appeal for LBW but turned down! A full-length ball, on middle and leg. Ghosh looks to flick it away but misses. The bowler appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Down leg.
Full and outside off. Deol leans in and pushes it to cover for a single.
Full and on the pads. Deol flicks it to the left of the keeper.
Outside off, Deol looks to chase it but misses.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Deol looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
Who will walk out next? Harleen Deol it is.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Australia Women are back on top. Pooja Vastrakar goes back after hitting a good boundary. Carey fires in a yorker, on off. Vastrakar looks to heave it away to the leg side but misses. The ball sneak underneath the blade and disturbs the furniture behind. Carey picks up her second wicket.
FOUR! Nicely played! Pooja Vastrakar takes the charge now. A full-length ball, on off. Vastrakar lifts it towards wide long off for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Ghosh looks to chase it but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! India Women lose another wicket in a short space. She looks to clear cover but does not get the height on it. A length ball, on off. Kaur hangs back and lifts it towards cover. Meg Lanning leaps and take a really good catch with both hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Meg Lanning b Annabel Sutherland

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on middle. Kaur defends it back to the bowler.
Vastrakar gets off the mark. A length ball, on off. Vastrakar pushes it to mid off for another run.
A full-length ball, outside off. Kaun slashes it through covers for a single.
CLOSE! A length ball, on the bodyline. Kaur looks to pull it away. The ball hits the gloves and lobs to just fall behind the stumps.
On off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
Pooja Vastrakar walks out at number 5.

OUT! TAKEN! Is that the wicket which wins Australia the game? Smriti Mandhana was well set, she was striking the ball really well and needed to stay out there. Carey gets the big wicket. This is fuller and on middle, Mandhana looks to go over covers. She loses her shape as she tries to hit it. Ends up hitting it high up in the air towards cover. Meg Lanning takes a good catch running back.
Commentary.Howout: c Meg Lanning b Nicola Carey

Commentary.Commentary: Mandhana makes room! She is followed with a full one. She swings but misses.
On off, Kaur pushes it down to long off for one.
Now follows the boundary with a single as this is pushed down to long on.

FOUR! Really good shot! Playing with the field! Mandhana moves right across, this is a full toss on middle, it is lifted over square leg for a boundary. This also brings up her half century. Brilliant knock.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On the pads, Kaur plays the paddle sweep towards short fine leg for one.
Mandhana whips it towards deep mid-wicket for another single.
On off, this is cut through point for one.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.
FOUR! Up and over! Mandhana comes down the track and lofts it over mid off. Bags a boundary. Once agian an over starts with a boundary.
A single as this is eased down to long on. 11 from the over. A really good one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Really well hit! On middle, Kaur plays the sweep, it is nailed in between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket. Boundary.
Superb fielding! Shorter and outside off, it is cut hard but to point where the fielder dives to her right and stops it.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
FOUR! Lovely stuff! Comes down the track and lofts it over mid off. Another boundary. Good start to the over. Need to make it count now.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Angled into the pads, Mandhana looks to whip it but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Mandhana comes down the track and lofts it down to long on for one.
A single as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Kaur is off the mark! On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg.
On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one.
Harmanpreet Kaur walks out now.

OUT! TAKEN! So just as this stand started to get a move on, Jemimah Rodrigues departs! She skips down the track, gets to the pitch of it and looks to loft it over long off. Does not hit it all that well and holes out to Tayla Vlaeminck.
Commentary.Howout: c Tayla Vlaeminck b Georgia Wareham

Commentary.Commentary: Comes down the track and pushes it through covers for one.
Plays the sweep through square leg for one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Jemimah Rodrigues comes down the track and hits it over mid on. Another boundary.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! On middle, Mandhana skips down the track and hits it hard through mid on. Boundary.
A single as this is hit to mid on.
Close! Shorter and just outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to cut but this one stays low.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A dot to end! On off, Mandhana looks to push but finds cover.
Another single only! Outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to drive, it goes off the underedge on the off side for one.
Comes down the track and pushes it through covers for one.

That looked close! No real appeal from the bowler or the keeper! This lands on middle and then straightens. Mandhana looks to sweep but misses. It hits her high on the pads. It is going over probably.
Another single! Outside off, this is driven through covers for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Smriti Mandhana got some blow on her elbow. She looks to be in some pain. The physio comes out running to have a look. The magic spray comes out now. It looks like she is fine to continue.
A single to end a good over! On off, Mandhana looks to hit it over the leg side, she gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
Direct hit and it could have been curtains for Jemimah Rodrigues! On off, this is pushed to cover. They go for one. The fielder runs in and underarms it but misses the stumps.
Outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues looks to cut but no connection.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled down to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Put away! Runs starting to come now! Angled into the pads, this is whipped over mid-wicket. It is in the gap. Boundary.
Shorter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues slashes at it, it goes more off the outside edge down to third man for a boundary.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed to covers.
Shorter and outside off, Jemimah Rodrigues guides it to point. No runs.
Two more! On middle, Jemimah Rodrigues works it through mid-wicket. Two taken.
The sweep comes out agian! This is played through square leg for two.
On the bounce! Mandhana comes down the track and lofts it over covers. On the bounce to the fielder in the deep. One taken.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Georgia Wareham comes into the attack now.
Mandhana comes down the track but the length is shortened. It is pushed to mid off. A quiet start then for India. They are 28 for 1 after the first 6.
On off, Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it to covers.
Slightly shorter and outside off, stays low. Jemimah Rodrigues looks to cut but misses.
On the pads, Mandhana looks to sweep but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side for one. Leg bye.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Confusion but safe! On middle, Jemimah Rodrigues defends it to the right of the bowler. The batters think of a run but then bail out.
Sophie Molineux comes into the attack now.
Full and on the pads. Mandhana flicks it to mid-wicket. A good over for India Women. 14 runs coming off it.
FOUR! Crunched! A length ball, outside off. Mandhana stays back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
WIDE! A length ball, sliding down leg. Mandhana looks to heave it away but misses. Wide called. 10 runs off the over already.
WIDE! Good length and way outside off. Mandhana leaves it alone. The umpire does signal a wide this time.
FOUR! The sound of the bat says it all. Slightly short and on off. Mandhana goes back, swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball, outside off. Mandhana looks to heave it away but misses.
Full and wide outside off. Mandhana leaves it alone. Umpire says it is inside the tramline.

FOUR! Nicely played. Mandhana gets on the attack from the first ball. This boundary will surely ease some pressure. Low full toss, on the pads. Mandhana whips it across the line through square leg for a boundary.
Another single. The pressure is mounting on India. Flatter and on the pads. Mandhana lobs it over mid-wicket for another single. India need some boundaries to ease the pressue.
Floated and on middle. Rodrigues comes across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Rodrigues goes back and cuts it to point.
Full and outside off. Mandhana pushes it through cover for a single.
Floated and on off. Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
On the pads, tucked to square leg for a single.
A great over by Tayla Vlaeminck. Just 2 runs off it. A full-length ball, on off. Mandhana pushes it to mid off on the up.
CLOSE! Good-length ball, outside off. Mandhana looks to pull it away. The ball takes the inside edge and scoots past the off stump and into the keeper's mitts.
On a length, outside off. Rodrigues runs it down to third man for a single.
A single now! Touch short and on leg. Mandhana hangs back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Bangs in a short ball, on middle and off. Mandhana sways away from the line of the delivery.
A length ball, around off. Mandhana looks to push it to the off side, but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full and on off. Mandhana works it to long on for a single.
Flatter and on off. Mandhana pushes it to mid off.
Full and on middle. Rogrigues tucks it to mid-wicket for a single. She gets off the mark.
On off, guided to third man.
Who will wal out next? Jemimah Rodrigues it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ashleigh Gardner draws the first blood. Shafali Verma departs on just 1. She is very disappointed. Short and on middle. Verma swivels and pulls it towards short fine leg. There is a fielder stationed there. Tayla Vlaeminck takes a good catch to her right.
Commentary.Howout: c Tayla Vlaeminck b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on the pads. Verma flicks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Full and down leg. Verma leaves it alone. Wide called.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Ashleigh Gardner.
On a length, around off. Mandhana works it to mid-wicket off the inside edge.
A length ball, on off. Mandhana looks to defend it out. The ball takes the inside edge and hits her pads.
Good length and on off. Mandhana defends it back to the bowler.
EDGY! Verma is off the mark in a streaky manner. A length ball, on off. Verma hangs back and looks to defend it out. The ball takes the outside edge and goes to third man. They take one.
India Women and Smriti Mandhana are off the mark. Short and on leg. Mandhana pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
BEATEN! A length ball, around off. The ball nips away. Smriti Mandhana looks to hit it down the ground but misses. The ball beats the outside edge.
